notes.title: Vietnam ’65 Napalm Version 1.11 Update!
notes.content:
[i]"We were succeeding. When you looked at specifics, this became a war of attrition. We were winning.”[/i] (William Westmoreland – Chief of Staff of the US Army from 1968 to 1972)

[b]Vietnam ’65[/b] has been updated to what we could call [b]“the Napalm Upgrade”![/b] 

Releasing today this [b]new version[/b] of the game introduces major changes that not only affect the gameplay but also the overall replay value and immersion level! 

A custom game mode with 10 variables to tweak, combat modifiers, fog of war, zones of control mechanics, village and unit names, weather, hex overlays on maps, and many other new features come together for a completely overhauled Vietnam experience!

Be sure to check the entire changelog [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336080/discussions/0/613958868355325281/]here[/url]

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Art/V65/gif_zac_light_steam.gif[/img]
[i]Map [/i]

	[u][img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Art/V65/gif_sweep_mines_633.gif[/img][/u]
[i]Sweeping Mines[/i]

notes.title: Vietnam 65 major update is coming!
notes.content:
[i]/These boots are made for walking, and that's just what they'll do
one of these days these boots are gonna walk all over you/[/i] (Nancy Sinatra, These boots are made for Walkin’ -  1966)

Good morning Vietnam (players)!

Since its release in March, [b]Vietnam ’65[/b] has gained the favour of an ever expanding fan community, and the developers have been working hard to make the game even better. 

Many suggestions and requests have been made and discussed, and the results of this fascinating [i]joint venture[/i] between players and developers will soon be revealed in the form of a [b]significant update of the game scheduled for the beginning of May![/b]

The new version has many new features and bug fixes, along with several specific popularly requested improvements, [b]like fog of war, names for US bases and units, combat modifiers (including weather, level of supply...) and custom game options.[/b]

You can get more information about this major patch by clicking [url=http://www.slitherine.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=329&t=63820]here.[/url]

tags.feature: - like fog of war, names for US bases and units, combat modifiers (including weather, level of supply...) and custom game options.
